property_summary: For any owner caller and any fuzzed (logger, status), after calling setApprovedLogger(logger, status) the mapping approvedLoggers(logger) equals status; the mutant that stores !status will make this equality fail for some fuzzed inputs.
change_summary: Replace the assignment that sets approvedLoggers[_logger] = _status with the inverted boolean assignment, storing ! _status instead of _status.
